note: Single source of truth for the fields that may appear in a scheme rule and in household facts. Derived from PROJECT_BRIEF.md. Money is in whole rupees, land is in square metres, no decimals anywhere. Nothing outside 'fields' may appear in a rule; the scheme loader rejects any rule that references an unknown field.

state.ALL: Reserved marker on a SchemeVersion meaning a central (all-India) scheme. It is never a valid value for a household's state.

state.description: State or union territory of residence. Compared case-insensitively against a scheme's state.

annualIncome.description: Total household income per year, in whole rupees.

monthlyPension.description: Government pension already received per month, in whole rupees. 0 means none; absent means not known.

ownsCultivableLand.description: Whether the household owns cultivable agricultural land.

landAreaSqm.description: Area of land held, in whole square metres. 1 acre = 4047 sqm, 1 hectare = 10000 sqm.

paysIncomeTax.description: Whether any member of the household paid income tax in the last assessment year.

age.description: Age in completed years of the household member the check is about.

gender.description: Gender of the household member the check is about.

maritalStatus.description: Marital status of the household member the check is about.

disabilityPercent.description: Certified disability percentage. 0 means none; absent means not known.

studentClass.description: School class currently enrolled in, 1 to 12. ASSUMPTION: modelled as an integer school class; confirm whether post-school levels (UG/PG) must be representable.
